programme.title: Isles of the Queen
programme.desc: Paradisiacal seas, reefs and exquisite sandy beaches: the Bermuda islands are the most northerly of all the Caribbean islands. Since the 17th century, the islands have belong to the British Crown. Then and today, they represent a vital bridgehead into America. Here, the Queen still reigns – with pomp and splendour.

programme.title: Exotic Destinations 101
programme.desc: Exotic Destinations 101 is a docuseries that explores hidden pieces of paradise around the globe. Each episode will feature stunning landscapes of a particular continent, diving into what Asia, Africa, America, Oceania and Europe have to offer, perfect.

programme.title: Rustic Adventures: Argentina
programme.desc: A hybrid food, travel and adventure show, Season 1 of Rustic Adventures followed two young, hot chefs who fulfilled their lifelong dream of building their own successful restaurants – from scratch – as they decide to take a much needed break and seek out inspiration for new endeavors while on a rustic food tour across Italy. Following Season 1’s adventures in Italy, the rustic adventures continue for young chef/owners Rob Rossi and Craig Harding as they head for the towering mountain ranges and rugged countryside of Argentina. From the Pampas to the peaks of the Andes they’ll find endless inspiration in this South American hotspot.

programme.title: Todo Bien
programme.sub-title: A Week Alone on Remote Beaches
programme.desc: Baja holds an almost mystical reputation in the overland community. In this series MAK and Owen traverse the full length of the Baja peninsula and explore the landscapes, wildlife and culture. They also sprinkle in tips for traveling in Baja to help anyone curious about travel south of the border.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.sub-title: Raw Travel: New York City: Big Apple for Beginners
programme.desc: Throw out the tourist map, Raw Travel is taking a fresh look at the Big Apple like never before. The crew takes viewers on a virtual trip to some of the best, hidden secrets NYC has to offer. Raw Travel delves deep into this amazing city’s diverse “off the beaten path” neighborhoods & boroughs showcasing a virtual melting pot of cultures and influences from all over the world.

programme.title: World Tour
programme.desc: In the thrilling travel show “World Tour,” viewers embark on captivating adventures to the most exotic corners of the planet. From the charming streets of Paris to the breathtaking landscapes of New Zealand, each episode offers new amazing places, cultures, and traditions. With inspiring stories from locals and unexpected discoveries, “World Tour” immerses viewers in the exciting world of travel and adventure.

programme.title: The 77: A City of Neighborhoods
programme.desc: Chicago’s Uptown neighborhood is a vibrant, bustling enclave that’s been shaped by distinct layers of history and culture. A longtime refuge for immigrants and LGBTQ+ communities, Uptown is one of the city’s most diverse areas. Dive into this unique neighborhood and come experience Uptown’s cultural richness for yourself.

programme.title: The 77: A City of Neighborhoods
programme.desc: Little Village is known for its diverse restaurants, colorful murals, and a thriving shopping district that attracts visitors from all over the region. Join us as we explore the hidden gems of “La Villita” and what gives this tight-knit community its resilient and entrepreneurial spirit.

programme.title: The 77: A City of Neighborhoods
programme.desc: Bronzeville has a long history as a hub for the African American creative community. The area’s many influential residents, including artists, writers, and gospel music pioneers, are honored with landmarks throughout the neighborhood. And that living legacy continues today, intertwined with the neighborhood’s many art galleries, classic eateries, and authentic character.

programme.title: The 77: A City of Neighborhoods
programme.desc: The energy is palpable in Humboldt Park, home to a thriving Puerto Rican community. The centerpiece of the neighborhood is the Paseo Boricua, a colorful cultural corridor that proudly showcases the history, culture, and cuisines of Puerto Rico. Join us as we meet a few of the area’s inspiring residents and multi-generational businesses.

programme.title: The 77: A City of Neighborhoods
programme.desc: The history — and future — of these neighboring communities are inextricably intertwined. Home to Chicago’s only National Historical Park, Pullman and Roseland have played a key role in urban planning, labor rights, transportation, and beyond. Today, despite decades of disinvestment, innovative community-led initiatives have started shifting the narrative of these deeply historic neighborhoods.

programme.title: Our Dominicana
programme.desc: Put away the parasol & lace up your shoes to join proud islander, Judith Rodriguez Perez, on a journey discovering the vibrant heart of the Dominican Republic. Venture beyond the beaches and see the island as the locals do. Dive into Our Dominicana.

programme.title: The Next Turn
programme.desc: Unplanned experiences leave the biggest impact. Watch this episode of The Next Turn, a docu-style travel series, powered by Expedia and Visit Orlando, as it takes host Jo Franco on a journey to embrace adventure to discover the Orlando she never knew. Also an adventure in Azerbaijan, join filmaker Jade Healy as she ventures to the other side of the world to find inspiration in the local tales and colours of Azerbaijan.

programme.title: Super Supper Clubs
programme.desc: Super Supper Clubs showcases the very best Jordan has to offer through the passion of local chefs, who share some of the country's most fascinating sights, and produce with us before hosting the dinner party of a lifetime.

programme.title: Expedia Presents
programme.desc: Four Corners, in partnership with the Dominican Republic, takes viewers on an immersive journey through the vibrant culture, history, and adventure of the Dominican Republic alongside travel ambassadors Renee Hahnel, Achieng Agutu, Emily Sanchez, and Matthew Hahnel as they explore Santo Domingo, Jarabacoa, Samaná, and Puerto Plata.
